entries.title: Leviticus 18:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 18:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.

words.text: unto them, I am the LORD

entries.title: Leviticus 18:3
segments: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:4
segments: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:5
segments: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:6
segments: ¶None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover [their] nakedness: I [am] the LORD. {near...: Heb. remainder of his flesh}

entries.title: Leviticus 18:7
segments: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she [is] thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:8
segments: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it [is] thy father's nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:9
segments: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, [whether she be] born at home, or born abroad, [even] their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:10
segments: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, [even] their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs [is] thine own nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:11
segments: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she [is] thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:12
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she [is] thy father's near kinswoman.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:13
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she [is] thy mother's near kinswoman.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:14
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she [is] thine aunt.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:15
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she [is] thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:16
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it [is] thy brother's nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:17
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; [for] they [are] her near kinswomen: it [is] wickedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:18
segments: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex [her], to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life [time]. {a wife...: or, one wife to another}

words.text: , beside the other in her life
[time]. {a wife...: or, one wife to another}

entries.title: Leviticus 18:19
segments: ¶Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

words.text: , as long as she is put apart

entries.title: Leviticus 18:20
segments: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:21
segments: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through [the fire] to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I [am] the LORD. {Molech: Gr. Moloch}

entries.title: Leviticus 18:22
segments: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it [is] abomination.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:23
segments: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it [is] confusion.

words.text: thyself therewith: neither shall any woman

entries.title: Leviticus 18:24
segments: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

words.text: not ye yourselves in any of these things
: for in all these the nations

entries.title: Leviticus 18:25
segments: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

words.text: thereof upon it, and the land

entries.title: Leviticus 18:26
segments: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit [any] of these abominations; [neither] any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

entries.title: Leviticus 18:27
segments: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which [were] before you, and the land is defiled;)

entries.title: Leviticus 18:28
segments: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that [were] before you.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:29
segments: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit [them] shall be cut off from among their people.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:30
segments: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that [ye] commit not [any one] of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I [am] the LORD your God.

words.text: not yourselves therein: I [am] the LORD
